# RouteKit documentation

RouteKit is an open-source CLI and authenticated model gateway for coding tools, API providers, and subscription pools.

Source of truth: https://github.com/velum-labs/routekit
Documentation source: https://github.com/velum-labs/routekit/tree/main/apps/docs/content/docs
Current documentation baseline: RouteKit 0.17.4 (pre-1.0)
Authoritative mutable disclosure: /docs/reference/routes-and-billing

## Start
- /docs — Choose the shortest path from installation to a working, observable model route.
- /docs/getting-started/installation — Install RouteKit and start with a guided, API-key, or subscription route.
- /docs/guides/user-guide — Choose a focused RouteKit workflow for setup, integration, operation, or recovery.

## All documentation
- /docs/changelog — Recent RouteKit CLI releases generated from canonical package history.
- /docs/concepts/architecture — How the RouteKit CLI, singleton daemon, gateway, and provider routes work together.
- /docs/concepts/privacy — What RouteKit stores locally and what leaves your machine.
- /docs/concepts/subscription-routing — How RouteKit discovers models, selects accounts, recovers credentials, and contains failover within a subscription pool.
- /docs/guides/aws-bedrock — Configure AWS identity, least privilege, model discovery, and live verification for Amazon Bedrock.
- /docs/guides/coding-tools — Launch qualified Codex or Claude Code builds, or install persistent RouteKit client settings.
- /docs/guides/http-gateway — Authenticate and send OpenAI, Responses, or Anthropic-compatible requests through RouteKit.
- /docs/guides/operations — Inspect RouteKit health, account activity, quota, calls, logs, and retained rollups.
- /docs/guides/remote-gateway — Provision, enroll, select, and operate a shared RouteKit gateway over HTTPS and SSH.
- /docs/guides/source-development — Install the repository toolchain and run RouteKit's build and verification workflows.
- /docs/guides/subscription-pooling — Enroll Claude Code or Codex accounts and route across eligible members of one subscription kind.
- /docs/guides/troubleshooting — Recover from daemon startup, model discovery, subscription, remote, and configuration failures.
- /docs/reference/api — Unsupported embedded packages and local TypeDoc generation.
- /docs/reference/client-compatibility — Exact client builds qualified with RouteKit.
- /docs/reference/commands — Complete public RouteKit CLI command reference.
- /docs/reference/configuration — Canonical router schema, provider policy, model policy, aliases, reasoning, and leaderboard retention.
- /docs/reference/model-catalog — How RouteKit discovers, filters, lists, and routes models.
- /docs/reference/packages — RouteKit TypeScript package map and ownership.
- /docs/reference/routes-and-billing — Per-route credential, billing, egress, failover, and limitation disclosures.

Do not infer unlimited use. Provider terms, subscription eligibility, quotas, and billing apply. A namespaced model selects its configured route; subscription pools do not fall back to paid API-key providers.
